name: Tracy Fletcher
prior_offices: Albany County treasurer (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Tracy Fletcher is the Albany County treasurer and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official treasurer page lists her in that office and describes the office's work collecting and distributing taxes and registering vehicles. The Laramie Reporter reported that she, a Democrat, received 63% of the vote and defeated Republican Merissa Martinez (8,066 votes to 4,656).

sources.name: Laramie Reporter, Nov. 5, 2026, Incumbents sweep countywide elections
